folds.heading: ## Later bounded native research, 2026-11-04 (B30)
folds.body: The original October7 no-native-recovery paragraph is its own snapshot. Later aspects-2026-10-14 and emergence-2026-10-15 checkpoints preserve selected native analysis through round5: healing consumers, active-effect timing/source cleanup, reservation/count/output paths, cancellation containment and exception cleanup. Read the matching round’s REPORT/TRACE and cumulative COVERAGE/UNREAD before selecting more work; the earlier absence statement is not today’s complete coverage inventory. These partial passes still do not establish whole-engine AI, general consumed-source refund, transformation reversal, output-placement rollback or native save/play behavior. Definition-memory cleanup, active-instance removal, source contribution reset and actual actor-state restoration remain distinct. Do not repeat completed native capture or infer a universal missing refund from a local path.

scope: Reviewer supplied content dispositions. Explicit read_mode distinguishes fresh reading from inspected prior full-content review reused on unchanged inputs. No hash-inferred semantics or renewed historical behavior proof.
